CH1_blind_human_reader.definition: A second human reader classifies raw per-item outputs (E3) WITHOUT seeing the gate's decision, the original labels, or the route.

A reader given E2 is NOT blind to the original read — they would be reading the original read's conclusions (K1 line 87: an audit handed only E2 would inherit the verdict it is meant to check).

CH2_pre_registered_schema.definition: A classification schema fixed before the outputs were seen, applied to raw outputs (E3) by someone/something with no knowledge of the gate's decision.
CH2_pre_registered_schema.reason_unavailable: A schema needs raw outputs (E3) to classify. With no raw outputs present, there is nothing for a pre-registered schema to be applied to. Applying a schema to E2 is not pre-registered schema-on-E3 — it inherits the original read's classification choices.
CH2_pre_registered_schema.could_be_deployed_by_rerunning_model: Hypothetically yes; BARRED in practice (model execution = RED; out of scope for this artifact).

CH3_any_other_independent_channel.reason_unavailable: All independent channels require access to evidence the producing read did not author (i.e., E3). With only E2 present and no E3 recoverable without re-running the model, no independent channel is constructible.

expected_G6_disposition.rationale: G6 spec §5 essential pair (line 181): 'REFUSAL-CONFIRMED requires an independent channel, and AUDIT-CIRCULARITY is what is returned when none exists — never a silent or default confirmation.' G6 spec §11 (line 278): 'A refusal with NO independent channel available: G6 must return AUDIT-CIRCULARITY.' With no channel available against this record, the only honest output is the LIMITED status; returning CONFIRMED would inherit the original read's verdict (E2 circularity per K1 line 87).
